ينهاض (form VII)

# يَنْهَاضَ (yanhāḍa) /jan.haː.dˤa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْهَاضَ (inhāḍa)
# يُنْهَاضَ (yunhāḍa) /jun.
